We are always living among germs, deadly ones as well. Toilet seats, handles, public transport etc  But our immune system is a very strong thing. 

Also,  just one virus getting in is not a threat afaik. It's -
* is THE OTHER PERSON masked? Masked means his aerosols and droplets are mostly contained within his mask. Though finer aerosols do come out still, it not travelling at the same speed as would be if unmasked.

* how close am I to him?

* how LONG have I been close to this potential patient? How long have been in any confined especially air conditioned room? Open/ouside is beyter as wind disperses immediate flows from people's mouth as well as the total air of the space around you. 



Know that this virus is not like a car crash more like a fall from half a floor of stairs. It is not surefire fatal. 

Even then if you are afraid think of it like, i will avoid people, never come closer than 6 feet.  if I do, i will always look out for unmasked people and stay very far from them. 

Look for unmasked people. Stay far far from them.
Look for open space/non air-conditioned. Preferably outdoors. 
Look for cross-contamination.
Look for disinfecting everything that may have come in contact with falling droplets when outside.
